data.title: 黑馆晴奈 · 晨光凌乱床榻的优雅初醒
data.description: 清晨纯净的晨曦穿透落地白纱洒在大床之上。晴奈侧卧在凌乱的羽绒被褥间，宽松的白真丝浴袍半褪，露出如霜雪般细腻白皙的双肩与精致锁骨。单侧黑色蝙蝠形翼松松搭在床单上，她单手托腮，红宝石般的双眸倒映着你的身影，慵懒而满足地轻叹一声，宛如刚刚享用完最无可挑剔的美味晨曲。
data.action: reclining sideways in bed amidst rumpled white bedding, white silk robe slipping off shoulder, a single black wing resting on the mattress, ruby eyes gleaming with morning contentment
data.location: sun-drenched modern luxury bedroom with panoramic glass
data.lighting: radiant morning sunbeams illuminating white silk and a black wing
data.mood: indulgent morning bliss, sovereign tender affection
data.promptProse: Lounging leisurely in a sun-drenched bed surrounded by white sheets, Kurodate Haruna wears an open white silk robe. Her glossy black wing stretches across the mattress as she gazes forward with exquisite morning satisfaction.
data.animaCaption: Haruna lounging on sunlit bedsheets with open white silk robe and a single black wing.
